title: k-NN: how k shapes the boundary
sub: Background colour shows the neighbours' vote: blue for class A, orange for class B, purple where it's close.

frames.caption: k = 1: every training point owns its own Voronoi cell. The boundary is jagged and wraps around individual noisy points: low bias, high variance. Accuracy on 400 new points: 92%.
k = 5: votes average out single noisy points; the boundary follows the two moons. Accuracy on 400 new points: 94%.
k = 15: smoother still. Purple marks regions where the vote is close. Accuracy on 400 new points: 93%.
k = 51: most of the dataset votes everywhere, so the boundary washes out and misses the curved shape: high bias. Accuracy on 400 new points: 74%.
